name: Joe Mathis
why: The labelled candidate mugshot run with the 1998 treasurer race, and the only photograph of him found. Small newspaper halftone at the scan native resolution, contrasty, but full-face and in focus. Filed against the archive spelling Mathis. The Herald prints both spellings for the same candidate in the same election: its candidate list of 7 April 1998 sets the treasurer race as Carleton Ruminer and Joe Mathis, and its profile of 14 April spells him Matheis beside this portrait. He is also the right man for 1996-97: the paper calls him a two-year congress member in April 1998, and he signed a letter in April 1997 as Henderson freshman, so he sat in Congress in 1996-97, the year the archive records for Joe Mathis on the roll call of 29 October 1996. No second Joe Math- appears anywhere in the 1995-2000 Herald.
caption_quote: Name: Joe Matheis Hometown: Henderson Class: Sophomore Major: Business
id_note: Two label blocks run side by side under the story, each with its portrait immediately to its right: Carleton Ruminer left, Joe Matheis right. This crop is the right-hand portrait. The story beside it reads: the other candidate, Henderson sophomore Joe Matheis, has a little experience.

name: Jeff Oliver
why: The only photograph of him found. A front page news frame of Young Democrats watching the 1996 congressional results come in, cut to the one figure the caption places. Dark and grainy, and his own hand covers his mouth and chin, but the cap, brow, eyes and nose are legible at the scan native resolution. Published because the alternative is no face at all; replace it if a clean frame turns up.
caption_quote: Members of Western's Young Democrats, Bowling Green junior Jeff Oliver, left
id_note: The caption gives a position for him and only for him: Jeff Oliver, left, then Russellville sophomore Nicole Laster and Rick Malek. Three people sit in the foreground of the frame, a capped man at the left, a woman at bottom centre and a man at the right with his head in his hand. This crop is the left-hand foreground figure. The two blurred partial heads at the top and far edge are background and are not among the three named.

name: Leslie McClard
why: A large, sharp, evenly lit frame of her alone, made during her first year in SGA Congress, and the only photograph of her found. Cropped from a wider news picture to head and shoulders; nothing else was altered.
caption_quote: Recovery time: Scottsville sophomore Leslie McClard recovers after donating a pint of blood
id_note: She is the only person named in the caption and the only person in the frame; the picture shows one student reclining in a donation chair with her arm raised. The caption also quotes her by name and calls her a member of Alpha Delta Pi.

name: Leslie McClard

caption_quote: Recovery time: Scottsville sophomore Leslie McClard recovers after donating a pint of blood

name: Adam Howard
why: The only photograph of him found: his mugshot in the Herald People poll of 16 September 1997, taken in his first semester at Western and a year before the Congress term the archive records. Small newspaper halftone at the scan native resolution, but sharp, evenly lit and full-face.
id_note: Four portraits run in a row across the foot of the People poll, each above its own answer with the speaker's name in bold and hometown in italic directly beneath: Scott Foster, Somerset junior; Bradford Elmore, Bowling Green sophomore; Adam Howard, Florence freshman at the right. This crop is the right-hand portrait. Florence freshman in autumn 1997 matches the Adam C. Howard, Florence sophomore, who wrote to the paper in March 1999 as an SGA sophomore representative, and the Florence junior the paper profiled in April 2000 as the incoming vice president of administration.

name: Adam Howard
why: The same photograph, filed again at the year he served as vice president of administration. It is the only photograph of him found.
id_note: His name is set in bold beneath the right-hand portrait of the four in the People poll, with Florence freshman in italic under it.

name: Jason Chilton
why: The only photograph of him found: his mugshot in the Herald People poll of 14 October 1997, a year before the Congress term the archive records. Small newspaper halftone at the scan native resolution, but sharp, evenly lit and full-face.
id_note: Five portraits run in a row across the People poll at the foot of the opinion page, each above its own answer with the speaker name in bold and hometown and class in italic directly beneath. Chilton is the left-hand column and this crop is the left-hand portrait; the others are Darrell Dunn, Gabriel Gantt, Eric Willoughby and Tara McDonald. A Lawrenceburg sophomore in October 1997 is a Lawrenceburg junior in 1998-99, which is exactly what the Herald calls the SGA member Jason Chilton it quotes on 12 January 1999 (74:29, p. 6), so the mugshot and the Congress member are the same student. No second Jason Chilton appears anywhere in the 1995-2000 Herald.
